statement: Taliban attacks on provincial capitals lead to civil war violence levels, resulting in humanitarian needs for the affected population.
rationale: civil war violence levels requires a numeric battle-death threshold

statement: Unsafe return of Afghan nationals from Pakistan causes food, shelter and livelihood shortage upon their arrival at Afghanistan along with risk of persecution.
rationale: shortage and persecution risk lack measurable cutoffs

statement: La Niña in Afghanistan worsens drought and leads to widespread agricultural losses, water scarcity, and acute food insecurity in 2026
rationale: worsens drought / widespread losses lacks IPC or hectare cutoff

statement: Continued attacks between Pakistan and Afghanistan increase protection risks, food security needs, and access constraints in Afghanistan’s border provinces
rationale: continued attacks / increase protection risks has no event baseline

statement: Escalating clashes between Interim Taliban Authority forces and armed opposition groups in Badakhshan deteriorates food security and increases protection risks
rationale: subnational clashes between named forces in Badakhshan are ACLED-verifiable

statement: Resource-related clashes and political tensions in Tindouf camps restrict humanitarian access and increase protection risks for Sahrawi refugees
rationale: restrict access / increase protection risks lacks measurable cutoff

statement: Heavy rains in late August 2022 cause floods that affect previously affected areas, especially in the northeast, and new areas, especially in the southeast, aggravating the humanitarian situation.
rationale: late-August flood occurrence across named regions is verifiable

statement: Intensifying political violence approaching the February 2026 election in Bangladesh increases protection risks and constrains food, healthcare, and livelihood access
rationale: intensifying violence before election lacks an incident threshold

statement: Prolonged fuel shortages in Bangladesh worsen food security and disrupt health, telecommunications, and other essential services
rationale: prolonged fuel shortages / worsen food security lacks duration/price cutoff

statement: High public debt has reduced state capacity to provide public services including health services
rationale: reduced state capacity from high public debt is an unthresholded condition

statement: Increased violence in the capital and borders with Rwanda and DRC
rationale: increased violence has no baseline or count

statement: Increase of violent attacks on civilians and IDP camps in the Far North region
rationale: increase of violent attacks has no baseline or count

statement: Food shortages due to the blocked Douala-Bangui transportation route
rationale: blockade/closure of the Douala-Bangui corridor is a discrete verifiable event

statement: Increasing number of protests and increasingly violent clashes between security forces and demonstrators in urban areas in the lead-up to April’s presidential election.
rationale: increasing number of protests lacks a numeric baseline

statement: Escalating cross-border insecurity linked to the Sudan conflict increases protection risks and humanitarian needs in eastern Chad
rationale: escalating cross-border insecurity lacks an incident or displacement cutoff

statement: Escalating insecurity across the Lake Chad Basin increases displacement, protection risks, and humanitarian access constraints
rationale: escalating insecurity across Lake Chad Basin lacks a threshold

statement: An increase in paramilitary and National Liberation Army violence in areas previously held by the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia lead to displacement and access constraints.
rationale: an increase in paramilitary/ELN violence lacks a quantitative baseline

statement: Intensified territorial disputes among armed groups over illegal mining corridors in southern Bolívar lead to mass displacement and confinement
rationale: intensified territorial disputes lacks a quantitative threshold

statement: La Niña-driven above-normal rainfall and flooding in Colombia cause widespread crop damage, landslides, waterborne diseases, and food insecurity and malnutrition
rationale: widespread crop damage from flooding lacks a quantitative cutoff

statement: Peace talk end and military offensive against armed groups in Colombia escalate conflict and increase civilian casualties and displacement
rationale: termination of peace talks and launch of military offensive are discrete events

statement: Disputed polls lead to conflict intensification in Brazzaville.
rationale: formally disputed polls in Brazzaville is a discrete electoral event

statement: Worsening energy shortages and U.S. pressure lead to essential service disruptions and rising humanitarian needs in Cuba
rationale: worsening energy shortages and rising needs lack measurable cutoffs

statement: Increased intercommunal conflict and militia attacks in southwestern DRC trigger new displacements and worsen the humanitarian crisis
rationale: increased intercommunal conflict lacks an incident/displacement threshold

statement: The intensification of anti-MONUSCO demonstrations leads to recurrent suspensions of humanitarian activities and the inability to meet humanitarian needs for the affected population.
rationale: recurrent formal suspensions of humanitarian activities are verifiable

statement: The deployment of the regional military force leads to more displacement and increased humanitarian needs in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.
rationale: official deployment of the regional military force in eastern DRC is binary

statement: DRC general elections trigger heightened levels of violence, leading to increasing protection threats, population displacement, and food insecurity
rationale: heightened levels of violence around elections lacks a numeric cutoff

statement: The expansion of the areas under the control of the March 23 Movement (M23) in Nord-Kivu causes increased violence targeting Rwandophone communities, resulting in displacement and protection needs.
rationale: expansion of M23 control / increased violence lacks territorial/incident cutoff

statement: The impact of war in Gaza and the Red Sea blockade on Egypt’s economy limits access to food and increases malnutrition levels among children
rationale: Red Sea blockade is a discrete maritime interdiction condition

statement: Potential Red Sea disruptions from a US–Iran conflict reduce foreign currency earnings, heighten food insecurity, and disrupt services across Egypt
rationale: potential disruptions reducing foreign currency earnings lacks a cutoff

statement: The escalation of conflict in Amhara Region resulting in displacement of people, destruction of infrastructure and fatalities
rationale: escalation of conflict in Amhara lacks a quantitative threshold

statement: Forecast below-average Kiremt rains in Ethiopia threaten food production and livelihoods
rationale: below-average rains threatening food production lacks a mm/IPC cutoff

statement: Deterioration of food security due to COVID-19 and economic crisis
rationale: deterioration of food security due to COVID-19 lacks an IPC/price threshold

statement: Election delays contribute to popular unrest and violence in the capital before spilling into surrounding rural areas, causing delays in the delivery of food aid.
rationale: official election delay in Haiti is a discrete institutional event

statement: La Niña-driven above-normal rainfall and tropical cyclone intensification cause widespread flooding, an increase in water-borne diseases and malnutrition
rationale: widespread flooding and increase in disease lack numeric thresholds

statement: El Niño-driven above-average temperatures and below-average precipitation cause widespread drought in the Central American Dry Corridor (El Salvador, Guatemala, and Honduras), increasing food and health needs
rationale: widespread drought increasing needs lacks an IPC or rainfall threshold

statement: US fund freeze
rationale: official US fund freeze is a discrete verifiable donor action

statement: IRAN's Deportation Plan
rationale: state deportation plan enactment is a discrete policy event

statement: Poor planning and lack of infrastructural integrity
rationale: poor planning and lack of infrastructural integrity is a chronic condition

statement: Nationwide hartal calls or election boycott by major political parties
rationale: nationwide hartal call or major-party election boycott is a discrete declaration

statement: Increased IMF borrowing
objective: The Executive Board of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) approved a 38-month arrangement under the Extended Credit Facility (ECF) for Burundi.
rationale: attached objective specifies IMF Executive Board approval of a 38-month arrangement

statement: Further escalation of the war in Gaza
objective: The trigger is considered materialised once an Israeli ground invasion of Rafah starts.
rationale: attached objective specifies start of an Israeli ground invasion of Rafah

statement: Iranian retaliation following limited US airstrikes
rationale: interstate Iranian military retaliation following US strikes is binary

statement: Structural economic issues
rationale: structural economic issues is an open-ended background condition

statement: Exhaustion of strategic fuel reserves
rationale: exhaustion of national strategic fuel reserves is a discrete stockout event

statement: Number of military junta bases and towns captured by armed resistance groups
objective: No specific threshold present for the trigger.
rationale: ACAPS objective explicitly notes no specific threshold is present

statement: Increase in attacks of the military junta on captured bases and towns captured by armed resistance groups.
objective: No specific threshold for the trigger.
rationale: increase in attacks with explicit ACAPS note of no specific threshold

statement: Continued restrictions on humanitarian access
rationale: continued restrictions on humanitarian access lacks a measurable threshold

statement: Al-Shabaab exploiting political instability
rationale: Al-Shabaab exploiting political instability is unthresholded qualitative prose

statement: Extension or enforcement of goods bans
rationale: extension or enforcement of goods bans is a discrete regulatory action

statement: Disputed election results
rationale: formally disputed election results is a discrete electoral event
